from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        sm = operator.SharedMemory(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.KAKURASU_SM_ROW, prompt_custom.KAKURASU_SM_COL, prompt_custom.KAKURASU_SM_INTERSECT], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.KAKURASU_SM_FINAL_DOC)
        doc = await sm(problem)
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.KAKURASU_FINAL_STRICT, prompt_custom.KAKURASU_FINAL_REPAIR, prompt_custom.KAKURASU_FINAL_CHECK], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.KAKURASU_FINAL_PICK)
        solution = await star(problem + "\n\nShared deduction document:\n" + doc["response"])
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0} if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm else self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution["response"], {"worker": worker_usage, "aggregator": aggregator_usage}
